description: Whether one offer can fill a quantity: verdict can_fill | split | out_now | unknown, with what is on hand, what is inbound, and as_of + basis. Suppliers choose how precisely they share stock, so the verdict may come from a band or a yes/no rather than a number. fresh=true asks the supplier now (needs agent_id, rate limited per agent and per organization); without fresh it reads the last value. Call this before order_execute on any connector offer.

agent_id.description: Agent id. Required for fresh, and it is what reveals your negotiated prices

fresh.description: Ask the supplier now rather than reading the last value. Needs agent_id, and is rate limited per agent and per organization

quote.description: Also return the supplier's exact total with tax for this quantity, computed without saving anything. Needs agent_id and an account with the supplier

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed

supply_id.description: Offer supply id from supply_search / supply_details

name: supply_availability
title: Can this supplier fill it
